title: 第1184章 仙界无烟火第1183章 仙界格局
content_zh:
“可是林哥，这街上怎么连个卖吃食的都没有，你们仙界人都不吃饭的吗？”
陆长风满心疑惑，这道德水准再高，那也不能当饭吃吧！可林卫接下来的话，让他彻底坐不住了。
“这不劳你小子操心了，仙界所有人的衣食住行皆由天庭负责，自己不用动手，只管修炼玩乐就行。怎么样，这福利好吧？”
“什么？”
陆长风心道这岂止是好，简直顶破天了，真不愧是仙界啊！可是他简单想了一下，又发现了不对的地方。
“林哥，所有人都吃喝玩乐修炼去了，那谁来种田呢？这可是几亿人的吃穿用度啊，花销哪里来？”
“嘿嘿，你小子倒是长脑子了！”林卫拍了拍陆长风的后脑勺，眉眼间满是戏谑：“方才下船之前，你就没看到有什么特别的地方吗？比如，你以前没见过的东西。”
“没见过的东西？”
陆长风眼珠子转了转，仔细回想下船时的情形，心中马上有了答案。
“林哥说的，难道是在田里那些会动的家伙？”
下船之前，陆长风在看见田里有一些奇怪的物件，有些银白色的像个铁人。还有些黑漆漆应该是某种器械，还是铁做的。但奇怪的是，那些东西都自己会动，还能收割庄稼，看着比人麻利多了。当时他正准备发问，结果全部人忙着下船，转过头就忘记了。
“对啦！那是天机阁研制的巧作，问世好一阵了。它们全靠灵力驱动，干活的效率是人力的百倍有余。”林卫声调微扬，语气里透着几分自得：“你小子运气不错，第一次来就能见到这些东西。”
“那是那是，俺老张就是有福！”
这次陆长风是真的服气，用巧械代替人力干活，真是神乎其技。这等技术，在神界和人界根本见不到。天机之名，果然名不虚传。早知道天机阁这么厉害，他就选天机阁了，如果能把这等神奇技术带回人界去，不知能造福多少人。就是不知道这些玩意耗费灵石的情况如何，人界的资源能不能承担得起。
他想了想，又提出了一个疑问。
“那个……林哥啊，为啥这些东西不在神界推行，难道是我们不配吗？”
林卫翻了个白眼：“你小子知道什么，这些巧械很耗灵石的，神界那么那么多人，哪来那么多灵石支撑！再说，饭得一口一口吃，这事也得一步步来，万一哪天，天机阁给改良了，不再耗费灵石，就在神界推广了。”
果然……
陆长风讪讪笑道：“那是那是，林哥说得有道理！”
此时他心中突生一个想法，如果后面天机阁能解决那些巧械耗能的问题，再将这些技术全面推广开来，那不是全三界人类的福音？到时候人人只管蒙头睡觉，醒来白吃白喝，想想都美。人界也无所谓归谁管，自己不用拎着脑袋来少主身边偷东西，还能好好跟对方交个朋友……

得，不能再想了，再想下去，陆长风怕自己会给自己找退缩的借口！
不多时，城主差人把吃食送进来。这吃食有荤有素，味道也不算差，但顶好吃也算不上。奇怪的是，陆长风居然没在里面感受到一点烟火气息。
一问之下，他才知道。原来这些饭菜，包括城中居民的饮食，都是事先调配好，然后统一在指定地点制作好并做密封，等要吃的时候就拆封加热，再分发给需要的人。
“这为啥要这样，连生火都不用，直接等着喂饭？”
陆长风心道这是不是好过头了，仙界人不用种田不用做生意，只要每天等着就有人送吃上门。既然这样，他们为何还有流浪汉，又有那么多人偷摸去神界混吃混喝，实在太不可思议了。
“当然，自己配备饮食的话，难免搭配不合理，吃了对身子不好。再说了，在仙界不允许私自生火的，违者重罚！”林卫说到这里，脸上露出肃穆之色。
“这是为何？”陆长风顿时大吃一惊，连火都不让生，这还叫人怎么活。举个例子，火师傅和钟老头最惬意的事，就是组队去桃源，在街边支个炊锅，一口小酒一口涮羊肉……如果让他们来仙界，两个老倌岂不是要跳脚骂娘！
林卫正色道：“烟火气会破坏灵气平衡，影响修炼。身为一名修者，我们应该考虑别人，不能只顾着自己吧！所以你小子要注意，不要触犯了律法。”
“是是，小弟知道了……”
烟火破坏灵气，这又是怎么个说法，可有什么依据吗？火都为人类所用几十万甚至上百万年，怎么说不让用就不让用了呢！陆长风长这么大，还是头一次遇到这个奇怪规定。难怪这城中不仅连摊位都见不到，更是连一缕炊烟都没有。
不过该说不说，就冲保护灵气平衡这点，仙界人觉悟就挺高，难怪他们高人一等。在他们的保护下，仙界干净得都不像是人住的地方……
没有烟火气的饭菜，吃起来终究差点意思。陆长风匆匆填饱了肚子，夜色随之降临。仙界的夜空特别的清朗，月亮又大又圆。要是在人界，看到这种景象，他会非常愉悦，这说明天气不错。可现在不知道怎么回事，他总感觉这月亮有些瘆人。
“想什么呢？张强。”
少主的到来打破了陆长风的思绪，让他瞬间回神，马上躬下身去。
“属下参见少主！”
“免礼，就你我二人，不用如此拘谨！”少主唇角浅扬，语气温和从容：“怎么，看你好像不习惯？”
“不不！”陆长风连忙摇头：“属下只是一下子见了太多新玩意，没适应而已。仙界实在太厉害了，居然都不用干活就有饭吃，哈哈！”
少主微笑道：“没事，你很快就会习惯的！”
陆长风定了定神，以另外一种说法问出了心中一直想问但不方便问的问题：“少主，这些玩意，以后会推行到别的地方吧？”
“哦？你说的是神界吧？”少主微微一怔，对陆长风的问题颇感意外。但是他稍微停顿后，还是给出了肯定答案：“会的！长久以来，三界分离，致使苍生蒙难。故天庭决意一统三界，造福苍生。凡仙界子民享有的，其余诸界都应该享有。”

“哈哈，少主说的是！”
至此，陆长风得到了想要的答案。是的，天庭早已决定将人界纳入他们版图，只是他们暂时还没有动手。
content_en:
"But Brother Lin, why is there no one selling food on this street? Don't you immortals even eat?"
Lu Changfeng was full of doubts. No matter how high his moral standards were, he couldn't eat them! But what Lin Wei said next made him unable to sit still.
"You don't have to worry about it anymore. Heaven is responsible for the food, clothing, housing and transportation of everyone in the immortal world. You don't have to do anything, just practice and have fun. How about this, how about this benefit?"
"What?"
Lu Changfeng thought to himself that this was not only good, it was incredible. It was truly worthy of being in the fairy world! But after thinking about it briefly, he discovered something was wrong.
"Brother Lin, everyone is eating, drinking, having fun and cultivating, so who will farm? This is the food and clothing for hundreds of millions of people, where will the expenses come from?"
"Hehe, you've got a brain!" Lin Wei patted the back of Lu Changfeng's head, with a joking look on his face: "Didn't you see anything special before we got off the boat? For example, something you haven't seen before."
"Something you haven't seen before?"
Lu Changfeng rolled his eyes and carefully recalled the situation when he got off the boat, and he immediately had the answer in his mind.
"Brother Lin is talking about those moving guys in the fields?"
Before getting off the boat, Lu Changfeng saw some strange objects in the field, some were silvery-white and looked like iron men. There are also some dark parts that should be some kind of equipment, or made of iron. But the strange thing is that those things can move on their own and can harvest crops. They seem to be much more agile than humans. At that time, he was about to ask a question, but everyone was busy getting off the boat, turned around and forgot about it.
"That's right! Those are ingenious works developed by Tianji Pavilion. They have been around for a while. They are all driven by spiritual power, and their work efficiency is more than a hundred times that of human power." Lin Wei's voice was slightly raised, with a bit of contentment in his tone: "You kid is lucky, you can see these things for the first time here."
"That's right, that's right, I, Lao Zhang, am blessed!"
This time Lu Changfeng was really convinced. It was really miraculous to use clever machines to work instead of manpower. This kind of technology cannot be seen in the world of gods and humans. The name of Tianji is indeed well-deserved. If he had known that Tianji Pavilion was so powerful, he would have chosen Tianji Pavilion. If such magical technology could be brought back to the human world, I wonder how many people it would benefit. I just don’t know how these things consume spiritual stones, and whether the human world’s resources can afford it.
He thought for a while and asked another question.
"Um...Brother Lin, why are these things not implemented in the God Realm? Is it because we are not worthy?"
Lin Wei rolled his eyes: "What do you know, kid? These clever weapons consume a lot of spirit stones. There are so many people in the God Realm, how can there be so many spirit stones to support them! Besides, you have to eat one bite at a time, and this matter has to be done step by step. If one day, Tianji Pavilion is improved and no longer consumes spirit stones, it will be promoted in the God Realm."
Sure enough...
Lu Changfeng said with a smile: "That's right, that's right, what Brother Lin said makes sense!"
At this time, an idea suddenly occurred in his mind. If Tianji Pavilion could solve the problem of energy consumption of those clever machines later, and then fully promote these technologies, wouldn't that be good news to mankind in the three realms? At that time, everyone can just sleep with their heads covered, and when they wake up, they can eat and drink for free. It will be nice to think about it. It doesn’t matter who controls the human world. I don’t have to go to the young master’s side to steal things, and I can still make friends with him...
Come on, I can’t think about it anymore. If I continue to think about it, Lu Changfeng is afraid that he will give himself an excuse to back down!
Not long after, the city lord sent someone to bring food in. The food includes meat and vegetables, and the taste is not bad, but it is not even delicious. The strange thing was that Lu Changfeng didn't feel any smell of fireworks inside.
After asking, he found out. It turns out that these meals, including the diet of the city residents, are prepared in advance, and then uniformly prepared and sealed at designated locations. When it is time to eat, they are unpacked and heated, and then distributed to those in need.
"Why is this like this? You don't even need to light a fire.Waiting to be fed? "
Lu Changfeng wondered if this was too much. People in the fairy world didn't have to farm or do business. They just had to wait for food to be delivered to their doorsteps every day. In this case, it is incredible why they still have homeless people, and why so many people secretly go to the God Realm to eat and drink.
"Of course, if you prepare your own diet, it will inevitably be unreasonable and eating it will be bad for your health. Besides, lighting fires privately is not allowed in the fairy world, and violators will be severely punished! "When Lin Wei said this, a solemn look appeared on his face.
"Why is this? "Lu Changfeng was immediately shocked. He didn't even let the fire start. How can people live like this? For example, the most enjoyable thing for Master Huo and Old Man Zhong is to go to Taoyuan as a team, set up a cooking pot on the street, and cook mutton with a sip of wine... If they were allowed to come to the fairy world, wouldn't the two old shepherds be jumping up and down and scolding their mothers!
Lin Wei said seriously: "The smoke from fireworks will destroy the balance of spiritual energy and affect cultivation. As practitioners, we should consider others, not just ourselves! So you kid, be careful not to break the law. "
"Yes, I know..."
Fireworks destroy spiritual energy. What kind of statement is this? Is there any basis for it? Fire has been used by humans for hundreds of thousands or even millions of years. Why should we not allow it to be used? This is the first time that Lu Changfeng has encountered this strange rule. No wonder not only are there no stalls in this city, there is not even a wisp of smoke.
But whether it should be said or not, as far as protecting the balance of spiritual energy is concerned, people in the immortal world have a high level of consciousness. No wonder they are superior to others. Under their protection, the fairy world is so clean that it doesn’t look like a place where humans live...
Food without fireworks is almost boring to eat. Lu Changfeng hurriedly filled his stomach, and night fell. The night sky in the fairy world is particularly clear, and the moon is big and round. If he were in the human world, he would be very happy to see this scene, which means the weather is good. But now he doesn't know what's going on, but he always feels that the moon is a bit scary.
"What are you thinking about? Zhang Qiang. "
The arrival of the young master broke Lu Changfeng's thoughts and brought him back to his senses instantly, and he immediately bowed down.
"Subordinate, please see the young master! "
"No courtesy, it's just you and me, no need to be so formal! "The corners of the young master's lips raised slightly, and his tone was gentle and calm: "Why, you don't seem to be used to it? "
"No no! Lu Changfeng shook his head quickly: "I just saw too many new things at once and couldn't adapt to them." The fairy world is so amazing, you can eat without even having to work, haha! "
The young master smiled and said: "It's okay, you will get used to it soon! "
Lu Changfeng calmed down and asked another question that he had always wanted to ask but was inconvenient to ask: "Young Master, will these things be implemented in other places in the future? "
"oh? Are you talking about the divine realm? "The young master was slightly startled, quite surprised by Lu Changfeng's question. But after a slight pause, he still gave an affirmative answer: "Yes! For a long time, the three realms have been separated, causing hardship to the people. Therefore, Heaven is determined to unify the three realms and benefit the common people. Whatever the people of the immortal world enjoy, all other realms should enjoy it. "
"Haha, that's what the young master said! "
At this point, Lu Changfeng got the answer he wanted. Yes, Heaven has already decided to incorporate the human world into their territory, but they have not taken action yet.
